purpose: Define the smallest safe resident/multi-step packet-pattern measurement after the passing 32x1, 64x1, 128x1, and 256x1 packet-batch repeat-median shape sweep.
preconditions: the existing nonresident template command remains the CPU/GPU reference for packet-pattern coverage-output equivalence
resident execution must use an explicit patch-script or resident schedule rather than ad hoc --patch arguments
resident output capture must write a distinct candidate dump and report path before comparison

record: resident launch count or resident schedule record count when available

non_claims: dry-run command planning is not resident execution evidence
the packet-pattern patch script must exist before non-dry-run execution
the resident command surface does not claim speedup or broader BlackParrot support

resolved_pre_execution_blockers.name: template_runner_has_no_resident_schedule_surface
resolved_pre_execution_blockers.evidence: Earlier template command planning mapped shapes only to run_vl_hybrid --steps and did not pass --resident-steps, --patch-script, or resident-specific output paths.
resolved_pre_execution_blockers.resolution: run_hybrid_template.py now accepts --resident-steps with an explicit --patch-script and derives resident-specific dump and compare report paths for dry-run/command-plan review.

known_blockers_before_execution.name: blackparrot_packet_pattern_patch_script_not_materialized
known_blockers_before_execution.evidence: The source-backed template defines cfg_* host-probe inputs for packet batching, but no resident patch-script file is declared for the router packet-pattern sequence.
known_blockers_before_execution.required_resolution: Materialize a reproducible packet-pattern patch-script generator or prove that existing host-probe cfg inputs are sufficient for resident steps.

required: CPU reference and resident candidate are generated from the same cfg_batch_length, cfg_reset_cycles, cfg_drain_cycles, and cfg_seed values
raw full-state equality is not required or claimed
resident schedule application is recorded as GPU-side resident execution, not CPU fallback
fail_closed_if: resident mode falls back to nonresident --steps without recording that fallback
resident patch-script or schedule generation is implicit or local-only
candidate dump/report paths overwrite the existing 256x1 nonresident evidence
coverage-output manifest is missing or not the BlackParrot source gate

performance_policy.baseline: reports/blackparrot_bsg_wormhole_router_256x1_median.json remains the latest nonresident packet-batch baseline until this gate executes.
non_claims: not arbitrary BlackParrot or BaseJump STL acceleration
not a replacement for the existing 32x1 through 256x1 packet-batch evidence
